title: Two Counterexamples for e-means
abstract: arXiv:2611.22065v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: e-means (Bessa et al., 2026) combines exponential averaging and cluster revival. We give two counterexamples to its published recipe with higher final loss than standard k-means (Lloyd, 1982) from identical initial centers. Mass-based revival can destroy a global optimum and make the ratio of expected losses unbounded even with k-means++ seeding.

translated_title: 关于 e-means 的两个反例
translated_abstract: e-means（Bessa 等人，2026）将指数平均与聚类复活机制相结合。我们针对其已发表的算法方案给出了两个反例，证明在相同的初始中心条件下，该算法的最终损失高于标准 k-means（Lloyd，1982）。基于质量的复活机制可能会破坏全局最优解，即使使用 k-means++ 进行初始化，期望损失之比仍可能是无界的。
tldr: 本文给出两个反例，证明 e-means 算法在相同初始中心下最终损失可能高于标准 k-means，且其基于质量的聚类复活机制可能破坏全局最优解，导致期望损失之比无界。
en_tdlr: This paper presents two counterexamples showing that e-means can achieve a higher final loss than standard k-means from identical initial centers, and its mass-based revival can destroy a global optimum, making the ratio of expected losses unbounded even with k-means++ seeding.
